unit.why: A quoted passage from the Mabit's Beit Elohim explaining plague, divine decree, flight and the segulah of reciting Pittum ha-Ketoret; talmudic allusions (Moses receiving the secret from the Angel of Death, David's hundred blessings) are cited as proofs, not narrated as a story.
unit.boundary_note: Trailing heading 'סגולה לקדחת' belongs to the next division (item ה).
